I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message. I confirmed I have his correction: the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 84 seats. I said I won't do anything else, as he asked.

I also suggested he post the correction in #central-team himself, since the wrong number is still there from this morning. I didn't read that channel or edit anything in it. A seat count is an account fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat it here.
